(iv) Areas and trails shall not be located in officially designated Wilderness Areas or Primitive Areas. Areas and trails shall be located in areas of the National Park System, Natural Areas, or National Wildlife Refuges and Game Ranges only if the respective Bureau head determines that ORV use in such locations will not adversely affect their natural, aesthetic, or scenic values.
(v) Areas and trails shall not be located in areas possessing unique natural, wildlife, historic or recreational values unless the Bureau head determines that these unique values will not be adversely affected.
c) Operating Regulations:
(i) A person operating an ORV on Interior lands shall have a valid license or learner's permit to operate a motor vehicle in the State of his residence or in which the vehicle is registered, or if under licensing age, for his State of residence or vehicle registration, shall be accompanied by an adult who has a valid motor vehicle operator's license. In addition, no person shall operate an ORV on Interior lands: 
(a) In a reckless, careless, or negligent manner or in willful or wanton disregard for the rights or safety of other persons;
(b) In excess of established speed limits;
(c) While the operator is under the adverse influence of alcohol or drugs; and
(d) In a manner likely to cause excessive damage or disturbance of the land, wildlife, or vegetative resources, or endanger persons and property.
d) Vehicle Standards:
(i) No off-road vehicle may be operated on Interior lands unless it conforms to applicable State laws and regulations relating to registration, operation, and inspection requirements established for such vehicles.
(ii) All ORV operated on Interior lands shall be equipped with a proper muffler in good working order and in constant operation and that conforms to the laws of the State in which said lands are located, and no vehicle shall have a muffler cutout, bypass, or similar device. An ORV that produces unusual or excessive noise or other pollutants shall not be permitted on Interior lands.
